algorithm.description: Hashing algorithm used for passwords. «plaintext» is for tests only.

DashboardSettings.description: Root settings for the dashboard application.

host.description: Address on which the dashboard application will listen. The default listens on every interface, which a published Docker port needs. Use `127.0.0.1` to listen on the loopback interface only.

port.description: Port on which the dashboard application will be served.

metrics_port.description: Port on which the Prometheus metrics (`/metrics`) are also served, unauthenticated. Disabled by default. Metrics are always served on the dashboard port, under the dashboard authentication.

auth.description: Authentication settings for the dashboard. When not set, the dashboard requires a login with the `admin` user and a random password generated and logged at each boot. Use `type: none` to explicitly serve the dashboard without authentication.

devserver.description: Development server settings, only useful for internal frontend development.

public_url.description: Public URL of the dashboard application, used to generate absolute links, for example in notifications.

DashboardSettings.title: DashboardSettings

enabled.description: Enable or disable the development server.

port.description: Port on which the development server will be served (internal). The proxy will forward dashboard requests to this port, if enabled.

NoAuthSettings.description: Explicit opt-out: the dashboard is served without any authentication.

type.description: Authentication type. «none» serves the dashboard without authentication.

NoAuthSettings.title: NoAuthSettings
